question: GQ-008
subject: decision 1 re-verified — the headline number is a best case, not a rate
the_claim: "Repoint MiniMax traffic away from Bifrost — ~97% input-token saving"
what_holds: The DIRECTION, on every run without exception: proxy caches a non-zero amount, Bifrost returns exactly 0.
what_does_not: "~97%" as a saving rate. Measured across four runs the proxy delivers 11.9% to 97.1% depending on cache entry age. 97% is the best case, reached on a warm cache, not the expected value.
honest_headline: 12-95% input-token saving on repeated prompts, depending on cache warmth. Zero through Bifrost, always.
scope_correction_already_made: The decision also said repointing "changes gateway topology for every agent on this machine". Corrected earlier today: the patch is gated on effectiveModel === MiniMax-M3, so it touches 73 of 1,986 requests — 3.7%. That correction had not been carried into the decision file.
still_shaans: Applying it edits ~/.config/bifrost/claude-model-catalog.mjs, which every Claude Code session on this machine loads. A bad edit breaks all of them. The script takes a timestamped backup and has a rollback subcommand, but the decision to run it is not mine.
